old:
\section{Checking Measurements and Rebuilding Results}
\label{sec:app-analysis-tools}

\sourcefile{Data/analysis/inspect_measurements.py} provides
\texttt{read\_xlsx}. Workbook ZIP/XML parts are read with Python's
standard library, shared and inline strings are resolved, and sheet
names, source row numbers, and cell addresses are returned. Excel is
not run, and workbook formulas are not recalculated. Running the script
directly exports the workbook contents as JSON for inspection. Row
and cell identifiers link processed values to the original worksheet.

\sourcefile{Data/analysis/rebuild_results.py} uses that reader to select
completed records and calculate output power, voltage error, initial
efficiency estimates, and input-minus-output power difference. Original readings are
kept and exclusions are recorded; missing values are not filled, and
instrument disagreements are not resolved by assumption. Harmonic percentages
are explicitly transcribed arrays tied to source screenshots. Thermal
markers come from \sourcefile{Data/analysis/thermal_image_reference_table.md}.
Neither is an automatic instrument extraction or a new calibration.

The supplied switching and line-time-scale exports are also replotted.
The original local acquisition paths are tried first, with the included
raw copies used when those paths are unavailable. Exported amplitudes,
offsets, and times are kept. Switching period is estimated from
stated hysteretic thresholds and median edge spacing. The scripts save source and
output checksums, CSV data, file lists, figure descriptions, and processing
notes beside the results. Assertions check that the expected records were processed.

The scripts are run from the thesis root with
Python, NumPy, and Matplotlib available:

\begin{lstlisting}[caption={Commands to inspect the supplied workbooks and rebuild the thesis results.},label={lst:app-analysis-reproduce}]
python Data/analysis/inspect_measurements.py
python Data/analysis/rebuild_results.py
\end{lstlisting}

The rebuild produces the eight result figures and the
tables used in Chapter~\ref{ch:results} and
Appendix~\ref{app:data}. Instrument synchronization, calibration,
AC-coupled readings, and thermal dwell time still limit the measurements.
new:
\section{Measurement Processing}
\label{sec:app-analysis-tools}

Completed measurements were used to calculate output power, voltage error,
initial efficiency estimates, and input-minus-output power difference. Missing
values were not filled, and instrument disagreements were not resolved by
assumption. Harmonic percentages were transcribed from instrument screens, and
the thermal readings were taken from image markers.

The switching and line-time-scale waveforms were plotted with their recorded
amplitudes, offsets, and times. Switching period was estimated using hysteretic
thresholds and median edge spacing. Instrument synchronization, calibration,
AC-coupled readings, and thermal dwell time limit the measurements.
